readings.name: Mood

construct.measures: How good or bad you feel right now, from heavy to bright.
construct.boundary: Not Energy, the body's charge, and not Stress or Overwhelm, the weight and the load: a calm, tired evening can still read Warm.
construct.missing: Asked at every check-in. Missing means not asked there (a shorter depth, or a reading you retired) or left unanswered: unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: Down — the day feels dull and downhill
Bright — glad to be in this day
alternates: Easy — glad in a quiet way
Lit up — glad to be here

readings.name: Irritation

construct.measures: How short your fuse is: how easily small things get to you.
construct.boundary: Not Stress, the weight you carry, and not Mood: you can be low and patient, or irritable and otherwise fine.
construct.missing: Asked at every check-in. Missing means not asked there (a shorter depth, or a reading you retired) or left unanswered: unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: None — nothing is getting to me
Faint — a small thing or two scratched
Some — a shorter fuse than usual
alternates: Calm — nothing gets under my skin
Slight — a small thing or two grated

readings.name: Stress
readings.prompt: How heavy or urgent things feel

construct.measures: How heavy or urgent things feel, from nothing pressing to more than you can carry.
construct.boundary: Weight and urgency, never a count: how many things compete for your attention is Overwhelm's.
construct.missing: Asked at every check-in. Missing means not asked there (a shorter depth, or a reading you retired) or left unanswered: unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: Light — a little pressure, nothing urgent
Wound tight — pressure I can only just carry
Crushing — more pressure than I can carry
alternates: Mild — some pressure, easy to carry
Braced — pressure I can only just carry
Flattened — more than I can carry

readings.name: Overwhelm
readings.prompt: How many things are competing for your attention, even small ones

construct.measures: How many things are competing for your attention, even small ones.
construct.boundary: A count of what is on your mind, never its weight: how heavy or urgent it feels is Stress's.
construct.missing: Asked at every check-in. Missing means not asked there (a shorter depth, or a reading you retired) or left unanswered: unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

alternates: Busy — a couple on the go
Swamped — a great many at once
Flooded — far too much at once

readings.name: Motivation

construct.boundary: Not Energy, the body's charge, and not Confidence, trust in yourself: you can want to start with little in the tank.
construct.missing: Asked at the morning check-in alone. Missing at any other is not asked; a morning skipped or the reading left is unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: None — nothing pulls me to do anything
Faint — I'd rather not, but might
Middling — I'll do what's in front of me
Ready — there are things I want to get to
Pulled — I want to start now
alternates: Inert — nothing pulls me toward anything
Reluctant — I would rather not, but could
Keen — things I want to get to
Eager — I want to start this minute

readings.name: Confidence

construct.measures: Trust in yourself for the day.
construct.boundary: Not Mood and not Motivation: you can feel flat and still trust yourself with the day.
construct.missing: Asked at the morning check-in alone. Missing at any other is not asked; a morning skipped or the reading left is unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: Doubting — I expect to get things wrong
Shaky — unsure I'm up to it
Even — no strong sense either way
Solid — I trust myself with whatever comes
alternates: Unsure — I expect to get it wrong
Wobbly — not sure I am up to it
Certain — I trust myself with what comes

readings.name: Focus

construct.measures: How well your attention holds where you put it.
construct.boundary: Not Overwhelm, how much competes for it, and not Energy: a quiet head can still drift.
construct.missing: Asked at every check-in. Missing means not asked there (a shorter depth, or a reading you retired) or left unanswered: unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: Fair — I can focus with effort
Held — attention stays where I put it
Locked in — nothing pulls me off

readings.name: Loneliness
readings.prompt: How much meaningful closeness feels missing
readings.help: Not whether you want company right now, or how many people are around.
readings.meaning: how much meaningful closeness feels missing, not a wish for company or how many people are around

construct.measures: How much meaningful closeness feels missing.
construct.boundary: Not a wish for company or how many people are around: the appetite for people is Social energy's.
construct.missing: Asked in the morning and the evening. Missing at the afternoon is not asked; a check-in skipped or the reading left is unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: Distant — a fair bit feels missing
Cut off — all closeness feels missing
alternates: Walled off — all closeness feels gone

readings.name: Social energy

construct.boundary: Not Loneliness: you can miss closeness and still want no one around.
construct.good: neither end: it is context, not a score
construct.missing: Asked at the morning check-in alone. Missing at any other is not asked; a morning skipped or the reading left is unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: Empty — I want no one around
Low — one quiet person at most
Up for it — I'd enjoy people
alternates: Thin — one quiet person, no more

readings.name: Energy

construct.boundary: The body's, not the mind's: the pull to do things is Motivation's, the hold of attention Focus's.
construct.missing: Asked at every check-in. Missing means not asked there (a shorter depth, or a reading you retired) or left unanswered: unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: Buzzing — could run up a hill
alternates: Fizzing — could run up a hill

readings.name: Hunger

construct.measures: How hungry or full you are.
construct.boundary: The body's need for food alone.
construct.good: the middle: neither hungry nor full
construct.missing: Asked at every check-in. Missing means not asked there (a shorter depth, or a reading you retired) or left unanswered: unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

anchors: Full — satisfied, no wish to eat

construct.measures: How long you slept last night, in bands of hours.
construct.boundary: Length alone: how restful it was is Sleep quality's.
construct.missing: Asked at the morning check-in alone. Missing at any other is not asked; a morning skipped or the reading left is unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.

construct.measures: How restful last night's sleep was.
construct.boundary: Rest, not length: the hours are Sleep hours.
construct.missing: Asked at the morning check-in alone. Missing at any other is not asked; a morning skipped or the reading left is unknown, never read as low or high, and never filled in.
